spans.s:
mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं)
Happy.
E.
कं happiness, यस् aff.

f. (-म्पा)
1 A girl nine years old, a virgin.
2 A name of

DURGĀ.
3
The sign of the zodiac,

Virgo.
4

The socotrine aloe (Aloe perfoliata.)
6 Large cardamoms.
6 A species of metre of four lines, with four syllables in each.
7 A parasite plant.
E.
कन to shine, Uṇādi affix यक्, fem. टाप्.

mfn. (-य्युः-य्युः-य्यु)
Happy, prosperous.
E.
कं, and युस् aff.

m. (-शः)
A goblet: see कंस.

m. (-सः)
A proper name; KAṂSA king of Mathura the uncle and enemy of KṚṢṆA, by whom he was slain; as the foe of the deity, he is considered an Asura or demon.
mn. (-सः-सं)
1 A goblet, a drinking vessel; also कंश and कांस्य.
2 A metal, tutanag or white copper; also bell metal.
3 A measure.
E.
कमु to desire, सः Uṇādi aff.

n. (-कं)
A mineral substance, (a salt of iron?) used as an application to the eyes: see पुष्पकासीस.
E.
कंस, and क affix of similarity; of similar white colour.

m. (-रः)
A worker in pewter or white brass.
E.
कंस and कार who makes.

m. (-जित्)
A title of KṚṢṆA.
E.
कंस, and जित् who conquers.

m. (-हा)
A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU.
E.
हन् from हन, to kill; the destroyer of KAṂSA.

m. (-तिः)
KṚṢṆA, or VIṢṆU in that character.
E.
कंस, and अराति an enemy, the foe of KAṂSA; hence also कंसारि and other similar epithets: see the preceding.

m. (-रिः)
See the preceding.

n. (-स्थि)
Tutanag, white copper, any alloy of tin and copper.
E.
कंस white metal, and अस्थि bone, fig. substance.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Made of bellmetal, &c.
E.
कंस, and ठन् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fit for or relating to a cup.
E.
कंस, and छ aff.

n. (-यं)
White copper: see the next.

f. (-वा)
A fragrant earth: see तुवरी.

(इ ञि) ञिकनी r. 1st cl. (कनति)
1 To shine.
2 To desire or love.
3 To go or approach.

n. (-न्नं)
Fainting, falling in a fit or state of insensibility: in some copies this word is read कल्ल.

n. (-कं)
Gold.
m. (-कः)
1 The name of a tree which bears red flowers, (Butea frondosa): see पलाश.
2 Thorn apple, (Datura metel, &c)
3 Another plant, (Mesua ferrea): see नागकेशर.
4 Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) see काञ्चनाल.
5 A black sort of agallochum.
6 A shrub yielding a yellow fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.)
E.
कन to shine, अक Uṇādi aff.

n. (-कं)
The seed of the croton.

m. (-रः)
Borax.
E.
कनक, and क्षार flux.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A golden hatchet.
E.
कनक, and टङ्क a hatchet.

n. (-कं)
The royal parasol.
E.
कनक gold, दण्ड a staff, and कन् affix; golden-sticked.

m. (-गः)
Gold dust.
E.
कनक, and पराग pollen.

m. (-लः)
A Pala, a weight of gold and silver equal to sixteen Māṣas, or about 280 grains troy: see पल.
E.
कनक, and पल a Pala.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A piece of gold.
E.
कनक, भङ्ग what is broken off.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Golden, consisting or made of gold.
E.
कनक and मयट् aff.

m. (-सः)
Yellow orpiment.
E.
कनक, and रस juice.

m. (-द्भः)
Resin.

n. (-त्रं)
A gold cord.
E.
कनक, and सूत्र string.

f. (-ली)
A gold mine, golden soil.
E.
कनक, and स्थल place.

m. (-लः)
The mountain Sumeru.
E.
कनक, and अचल a mountain; the golden mountain.

m. (-क्षः)
The treasurer or superintendant of the gold.
E.
कनक, and अध्यक्ष a superintendant.

f. (-का)
A golden jar or vase.
E.
कनक, आलु a water jar, कन् and टाप् added.

m. (-ह्वः)
A tree with golden or yellow blossoms, (Mesua ferrea.)
E.
कनक, and आह्वा appellation.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
One-eyed.
E.
कन to shine, युच् aff.

nf. (-नं-नी)
1 A forest, a grove.
2 The face of

BRAHMĀ.
3

A house.
E.
कनि to shine, in the causal form, and ल्युट् affix, or क BRAHMĀ, and आनन a face.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Small, little.
2 Younger, younger born.
3 Young.
f. (-ष्ठा)
The little finger.
E.
कन् to shine, &c. and इष्ठच् affix, or कण small, the ण being changed, or कन substituted for युवन् and अल्प.

f. (-ता)
The state of being younger or smaller.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, कनिष्ठत्वं.

f. (-नी)
A girl, a maiden.
E.
कन to shine, अच् and ङीष् affs.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Very small: see कणिक.

f. (-चिः)
1 A creeping plant which bears flowers.
2 The Gunja, a shrub bearing a red and black berry, (Abrus precatorios.)
3 A cart.
E.
कनी to shine, ईचि Uṇādi affix; also according to some कणीचि.

m. (-कः)
The caruncula lacrymalis.
f. (-निका)
1 The pupil of the eye.
2 The little finger.
E.
कन to shine, ईकन् affix, कन added; also with ङीष् only कनीनी.

f. (-नी)
1 The little finger.
2 The pupil of the eye.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Very young, youngest.
2 Very small, least.
3 Younger born, a younger brother or sister.
E.
कण small, ईयसुन् affix, the ण being changed; or कन to shine, &c.: or कन substituted for युवन् and अल्प.

n. (-सं)
Copper.
E.
कन to shine, ईयसच् aff.

f. (-रा)
1 A female elephant.
2 A harlot.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Happy.
E.
कं and त aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Pleasing, agreeable.
2 Lovely, beautiful.
3 Dear, beloved.
m. (-न्तः)
1 A name of KṚṢṆ

The moon.
3 A husband.
4

Spring.
5

A precious stone; in which case it is compounded with सूर्य्य, चन्द्र or अयस्, as सूर्य्यकान्त a crystal lens, &c.
f. (-न्ता)
1 A wife, a mistress, any beloved or lovely woman.
2 A plant, commonly Priyangu: see प्रियङ्गु.
3 A grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.)
n. (-न्तं)
1

Iron.
2

Saffron.
E.
कम to desire, affix क्त.

mfn. (-न्तिः-न्तिः-न्ति)
Happy.
E.
कम् and ति aff.

f. (-न्तिः)
1 Beauty, splendor, light.
2 Female beauty.
3 Wish, desire.
4 A lovely or desirable woman.
5 Personal decoration or embellishment.
E.
कम to desire or be desired, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु)
Happy.
m. (-न्तुः)
1 KĀMADEVA, the deity of love.
2 The heart, as the seat or faculty of perception and feeling.
E.
कम to desire, तु Uṇādi affix; or कं and तु possessive aff.

f. (-न्था)
1 A rag, a patched cloth or garment, a quilt of grass.
2 A wall: this word in composition may be used as neuter, if the compound imply a town in the province of Usināra, as सोसिमकन्थं.

n. (-णं)
Wearing a garment of patch-work, the practice of some Yogis.
E.
कन्था, and धारण wearing.

mf. (-री)
A Yogi, a religious mendicant.
E.
कन्था, and धारिन् who wears.

mn. (-न्दः-न्दं)
1 A bulbous or tuberous root.
2 One of an esculent sort, (Arum campanulatum.)
3 Garlic.
m. (-न्दः)
1 A cloud.
2 An affection of the feminine organ, considered as a fleshy excrescence, but apparently prolapsus uteri.
E.
कदि to wet, &c. अच् affix, or कं water, and दा to give.

n. (-टं)
The white esculent water lily.

n. (-लं)
A radish.
E.
कन्द, and मूल root.

mfn. (-रः-रा or -री-रं)
1 An artificial or natural cave.
2 A glen, a defile, a valley.
m. (-रः)
A hook for driving an elephant with.
n. (-रं)
Dry ginger.
E.
क water, or the head, and दृ to divide, to pierce, अप् aff.

m. (-रः)
A mountain.
E.
कन्दर a cave, आकर having, making.

m. (-लः)
A plant, (Hibiscus populneoides.)
2 A species of fig tree, (Ficus venosa): see प्लक्ष.
3 The walnut tree.
E.
कन्दरा a cave, and लक्ष् affix; growing in desolate places: also with कन् added, कन्दरालक.

m. (-कः)
A species of fig tree: see the preceding.

m. (-र्पः)
A name of the deity KĀMA, the CUPID of the Hindu mythology.
E.
कं BRAHMĀ, दर्प to inflame, अच् affix; the inflamer even of the first of the gods; corresponding in this respect with his Grecian prototype.
f. (-र्पा)
One of the presiding female deities of the Jainas.

m. (-पः)
Pudendum muliebre.

m. (-रः)
Passion, desire.
E.
कन्दर्प, and ज्वर fever.

m. (-लः)
Membrum virile.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 The cheek, or the cheek and temple.
2 A portent, a natural phoenomenon supposed to announce evil.
3 A new shoot or spring.
4 A low minute tone.
5 Reproach, censure.
m. (-लः)
1

Gold.
2

War, battle.
f. (-ली)
1 A species of deer of which the hide is used.
2 A sort of tree, the banana: see कदली.
3 A flag.
E.
कन्द a root, &c. and ल from ला to take, fem. affix ङीप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Budden, blown.
2 Put forth, emitted.
E.
कन्दल a bud, इतच् aff.

n. (-मं)
A mushroom.

m. (-नः)
An esculent root.
E.
कन्द, and वर्द्धन increasing.

m. (-णः)
A sort of Arum, (A. campanulatum.)
E.
कन्द, and शूरण the same.

n. (-ज्ञं)
Prolapsus uteri, see कन्द.
E.
कन्द a root, and संज्ञा a name, affix ड; every संज्ञा or name for a bulbous root, being a term for this complaint.

n. (-रं)
The garden or grove of INDRA.

m. (-लुः)
An esculent root, a sort of Arum.

mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि)
Having a bulbous root.
m. (-न्दी)
A sort of Arum, (A. campanulatum, or any similar bulb.)
E.
कन्द and इनि aff.

mfn. (-न्दुः-न्दुः-न्दु)
1 A boiler, a saucepan or other cooking utensil of iron.
2 An oven or vessel serving for one.
E.
स्कन्द to go, उ Uṇādi affix, and the initial स rejected.

m. (-कः)
A ball of wood or pith for playing with.
n. (-कं)
A germ.
E.
कदि to cry, to call, &c. उ affix, and कन् added.

mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं)
Parched, roasted, (as grain,) fried, &c. dressed without water.
E.
कन्दु, and पक्व dressed.

m. (-टः)
The white esculent water lily.
n. (-टं)
The blue lotus.

m. (-तः)
The white lotus.

m. (-न्धः)
A cloud.
E.
कं water, and ध from धा to have.

mf. (-रः-रा)
The neck.
m. (-रः)
A cloud.
E.
कं water or the head, and धर having, from धृञ्, affix खच्.

m. (-न्धिः)
The ocean.
f. (-न्धिः)
The neck.
E.
क water or the head, धा to have, कि aff.

f. (-का)
1 A girl, a maiden.
2 A daughter.
3 The Socotrine aloe, (Aloes perfoliata.)
E.
कन्या A girl, कन् pleonastic affix, fem. affix, टाप्: see कन्या and कन्याका.

f. (-का)
A young girl or virgin: see कन्या and कन्यका.

n. (-लं)
Beguiling a maiden, seduction, betrayal.
E.
कन्यका, and छल deceit.

m. (-तः)
The son of an unmarried woman.
E.
कन्यका, and जात born.

m. (-तिः)
A daughter's husband.
E.
कन्यका, and पति a husband.

m. (-सः)
1 A younger brother.
f. (-सा)
The little finger: see कनिष्ठ.

m. (-ब्जः)
Kanyākubja or Kinnoge, an ancient city of great note, in the north of Hindustan, known to classical geography as Canogyza: the name also applies to its dependencies or the surrounding district; also कान्यकुब्ज.
E.
कन्या a girl, and कुब्ज round-shouldered, crooked; the etymology alludes to a legend relating to the one hundred daughters of KUŚANĀBHA the king of this city, who were all rendered crooked by Vāyu, for non-compliance with his licentious desires.

n. (-णं)
Taking a girl in marriage.
E.
कन्या, and ग्रहण taking.

m. (-टः)
The middle of a house; the inner or private apartments.
E.
कन्या a girl, अट to go, and अच् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Giving a girl in marriage.
2 Receiving the same.
E.
कन्या, and दान gift, or आदान acceptance.

m. (-ता)
A father, one who gives a girl in marriage.
E.
कन्या, and दातृ donor.

m. (-कः)
1 A violator or defiler of a virgin.
2 A calumniator of a girl.
E.
कन्या, and टूषक who defiles; also कन्यादूषिन् (-षी.)

n. (-णं)
1 Defiling a virgin.
2 Calumniating a girl.
E.
कन्या, and दूषण spoiling.

m. (-षः)
A blemish in a virgin, disease, bad repute, &c.
E.
कन्या, and दोष fault.

m. (-तिः)
A daughter's husband: see कन्यकापति.

m. (-लः)
1 A dealer in slave girls.
2 The father of a daughter.
E.
कन्या, and पाल who cherishes.

m. (-त्रः)
The offspring of an unmarried daughter.
E.
कन्या, and पुत्र a son.

n. (-नं)
Giving a daughter in marriage.
E.
कन्या, and प्रदान a gift.

m. (-मः)
A Bauddha or Jaina saint.
E.
कन्या a girl, रम to please, affix घञ्.

m. (-दी)
A son-in-law.
E.
कन्या, and वेदिन् who knows.

n. (-ल्कं)
The purchase money of a maiden, money given to the bride's father.
E.
कन्या, and शुल्क tax.

m. (-वः)
The son of an unmarried girl.
E.
कन्या, and समुद्भव born.

n. (-णं)
Carrying off a girl, rape, ravishment.
E.
कन्या, and हरण taking.

f. (-का)
A young girl, a virgin: see कन्यका.

n. (-षं)
The hand below the wrist.

mn. (-स्यः-स्यं)
A goblet, a drinking vessel.
n. (-स्यं)
1 White copper or brass, queen's-metal, any amalgam of zinc and copper.
2 A musical instrument, a sort of gong or plate of bell-metal struck with a stick or rod.
3 A measure: see कंस, &c.
E.
कसि to injure, ण्यत् aff.

n. (-कं)
See the preceding.

m. (-रः)
A brazier, a pewterer, a worker in white or bell-metal.
E.
कांस्य, and कार a workman.

m. (-लः)
Blue vitriol considered as a collyrium.
E.
कांस्य bell-metal, and नील blue or black; also written occasionally कांश्यनील.

m. (-रिः)
The Śami or Śain tree, (Mimosa albida): see समी.
E.
कानन, and अरि enemy; injurious to a wood; being a thorny tree.

mf. (-नः-नी)
The son or daughter of a young and unmarried woman.
m. (-नः)
A name of

VYĀSA.
2

Also of KARṆA, (being both born of mothers who were unmarried.)
E.
कन्या a virgin or young girl, changed to कनीन् and अण् aff.

f. (-ता)
Loveliness, beauty, splendor.
E.
कान्त pleasing, &c. तल् aff.

m. (-क्षी)
A peacock.
E.
कान्त beautiful, पक्षिन् a bird.

m. (-ष्पः)
Mountain ebony, &c. (Bauhinia variegata.)
E.
कान्त, and पुष्प flower.

m. (-कः)
A tree, the wood of which something resembles mahogany, commonly Toon, (Cedrela tunna, Rox.)
E.
कान्त, beauty, and र what gives, कन् added, and र changed to ल.

m. (-दः)
A tree, commonly Aśoka, (Jonesia asoca.)
E.
कान्ता a woman, अङ्ग्नि a foot, and दोहद desire; the tree being supposed to blossom upon coming in contact with the foot of a handsome female.

m. (-दः)
The tree Aśoka: see the preceding.

n. (-सं)
Iron stone: see अयस्कान्त.
E.
कान्त, and अयस् iron, अण् added.

mn. (-रः-रं)
1 A bad or difficult road.
2 A wood, a forest.
3 A hole, a cavity.
m. (-रः)
1 A red variety of the sugar cane.
2 A bamboo.
3 Mountain ebony.
n. (-रं)
1 A symptom or symptomatic disease.
2 A lotus.
f. (-री)
A sort of sugar cane.
E.
कान् for कञ्चित् any one, here meaning no one, तृ to go, in the causal form, अच् affix; allowing none to pass; or क pleasure, &c. अन्त end, and ऋ to go, अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A sort of sugar cane.
E.
कान्त good, excellent, (juice,) ऋ to go, to gain, अण् and कन् affixes: see the preceding.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Who or what goes into or in a wood.
E.
कान्तार, and ग who goes.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Beautifying, illumining, making handsome or splendid.
E.
कान्ति, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Beautifying, illuminating.
n. (-दं)
Bile, the bilious humour.
E.
कान्ति light, splendor, &c. and द what gives.

mfn. (-यकः-यिका-यकं)
Beautifying, adorning.
n. (-कं)
A kind of Curcuma, from the root of which a yellow die is pared, (C. Zanthorhiza.)
E.
कान्ति beauty, &c. दायक distributor, giver.

mfn. (-भृत्)
1 Handsome, beautiful.
2 Bright, shining.
E.
कान्ति, and भृत् what has.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
1

Splendid.
2

Beautiful.
E.
कान्ति, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Dimming, dulling, making dull or ugly.
E.
कान्ति, and हर what removes.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Roasted or baked, (in an iron pan or oven, as bread, cakes, &c.)
E.
कन्दु and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A baker.
E.
कान्दव baked bread, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Flying, running away, put to flight.
E.
कदि to fear, घञ् and इन् affixed, कन्दि; शीक to go, to ooze, घञ् affix, कन्दिशीक; and again, अण् affix, कान्दिशीक.

m. (-जः)
A country, the modern Kanouj; also कन्यकुब्ज

f. (-जा)
A kind of perfume, commonly Nali.
